rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING JURIDICAL PERSONALITY AND LEGAL CAPACITY TO THE BOARD OF THE FUND FOR RESPONDING TO LOSS AND DAMAGE DUE TO CLIMATE CHANGE
rows.title_short: Loss And Damage Fund Board Act
rows.abstract:
Aims to enable the Board to enter into a host country agreement with the President, as head of State, and facilitate the operationalization of the Loss and Damage Fund.
Grants the Board independence and freedom of action belonging to an international organization and the status, immunities, and privileges granted under the host country agreement entered into with the Government of the Republic of the Philippines (GOP).
Exempts the Fund and the Board from payment of all taxes, duties, and other changes imposed by the GOP and local authorities on their property, operations, and transactions.
Exempts the non-Filipino Fund officials and invited experts and observers form payment of income tax received fro the Fund regardless of currency used.

rows.title_full: AN ACT EXEMPTING INCENTIVES, REWARDS, BONUSES AND OTHER FORMS OF EMOLUMENTS RECEIVED BY NATIONAL ATHLETES AND COACHES FROM TAXES, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 10699, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE "NATIONAL ATHLETES AND COACHES BENEFITS AND INCENTIVES ACT"
rows.title_short: National Athletes And Coaches Benefits And Incentives Act
rows.abstract:
Seeks to encourage donations to fund training and competition-related expenses of national athletes by granting donors incentives in the form of tax exemptions and deductions from gross income.
Provides that all donations, gifts, endowments, and contributions made prior to the competition itself must be used exclusively for training and competition-related expenses to qualify for tax exemptions. The period for availing the exemption from donor´s tax and deductibility from gross income is within one year before the international sports competition and three months after.
States that exemptions provided cover incentives, rewards, bonuses, and other emoluments, as well as donations, gifts, endowments, and contributions received by the national athletes and coaches starting from January 1, 2024.

rows.title_short: Improving The Delivery Of Socialized Housing Programs, Amending For The Purpose Sections 10, 18, And 20 Of Republic Act No. 7279, Otherwise Known As The “ Urban Development And Housing Act Of 1992 ”, As Amended By Republic Act No. 10884, Otherwise Known As The “ Balanced Housing Development Program Amendments ”
rows.abstract:
Amends Section 10 of RA 7279 as amended by RA 10884 by including the direct purchase and unsolicited proposals as provided under the Public-Private Partnership (PPP) Act as modes of land acquisition and creation of socialized housing programs and projects.
Amends Section 18 by providing that owners or developers of proposed Housing Development Projects specified in the Framework plan shall be required to develop an area for socialized housing equivalent to at least fifteen percent (15%) of the Total Project Area or cost for subdivisions or villages and at least five percent (5%) of condominium or vertical housing area or project cost.
Amends Section 20 by providing the manner and more mode of incentives to the private sector for the purpose of Socialized Housing to encourage greater private sector participation and further reduce the cost of housing units for the benefit of the underprivileged and homeless.
